items.text: Be sure that the danger areas are clear before starting.
Stop the engine immediately if one of the following occurs
The engine must be stopped if there is;
- Idle RPM 35% is not reached after 60 sec’s
In case of fire continue with the following steps;
100% RPM max of 6 mins, then reduce to 97%
Level of maintain CAS or MACH number power about 90%
Normal decent is at 65% AT 300 KPH
Check speed/ distance for particular weight
